title: One Model Many Scores: Using Multiverse Analysis to Prevent Fairness Hacking and Evaluate the Influence of Model Design Decisions
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its findings are about how different model design and evaluation decisions (e.g., data stratification, classification cutoffs) can dramatically alter fairness metrics, a phenomenon the authors investigate using 'multiverse analysis'.
